strategies.name: Expiry-day straddle-width iron fly
strategies.description: Defined-risk iron fly sold at 09:45 on each index's own expiry day, wing width = ATM straddle price.

summary.headline: Sell ATM CE+PE at 09:45 on the underlying's own expiry day; buy wings at ATM +/- straddle price.
summary.entryRules: Entry 09:45 (after first 30m bar). Read ATM CE+PE=S. Sell ATM CE+PE, buy CE@ATM+S and PE@ATM-S.
summary.exitRules: Target 30-40% of net credit; stop at 50% of max loss; or underlying 30m close outside breakevens; hard exit 14:30.
summary.filters: Only on isExpiryDay(underlying) = true (NIFTY=TUE, SENSEX=THU). India VIX 11.5-16. Block if VIX up >8% intraday or a scheduled macro event falls inside the session.

references.title: Quantsapp backtesting library, NIFTY straddle-width iron fly, 1 Oct 2025-30 Sep 2026

riskNotes: activeDays below is TUE+THU combined for NIFTY(TUE)+SENSEX(THU); split into two Strategy records per-underlying if the scheduler needs per-index on/off control.

Extra 2% Extreme Loss Margin applies to short legs on expiry day (SEBI circular 1 Oct 2024); no calendar-spread margin offset on expiry day.
Evidence grade C: single-year (Oct2025-Sep2026), single-lot, Quantsapp backtest, mostly before live slippage.

strategies.name: Late opening-range breakout, long-biased
strategies.description: Buys a breakout of the 09:15-11:15 range; long side preferred per Zerodha's multi-year study.

summary.headline: Range = high/low of 09:15-11:15 (four 30m bars). Buy ATM CE on a close above range high; PE on a close below range low only with extra confirmation.
summary.entryRules: Buy ATM CE on 30m close above range high. Buy ATM PE on 30m close below range low only if price is also below VWAP and the 30m 20-EMA is falling.
summary.exitRules: Stop at range midpoint (underlying, translated to premium via delta); target 1.5x risk or 10% premium, whichever first; time exit 15:15; one trade/day.
summary.filters: Avoid range (choppy) days and expiry afternoons (gamma whipsaw). Apply G-DIR-LONGBIAS: require extra confirmation for PE breakouts.

references.title: Quantsapp 30-min ORB option-buying backtest

references.note: 2,122 trades, 48.7% win, +91.6% over 8+ yrs, Sharpe 1.16, best on Fridays/short side

riskNotes: Strong evidence (B) for the underlying signal; weak/negative evidence for the option-buying translation -- Zerodha's own option-buying version won only ~48% of trades, and Quantsapp's 30-min ORB option buying lost Rs70.5k/yr.
IntradayLab's result contradicts Zerodha's long bias (found the edge clearest on Fridays, short side) -- resolve this with your own walk-forward test before trusting either direction.
PAPER ONLY until your own test is positive after costs.

rules.conditionText: Max 6 trades/day across the platform; max 2 per strategy.

evidence.note: SEBI FY26: ~Rs24,800cr transaction costs; costs drove the retail loss share from 82.1% (before costs) to 87.7% (after).

rules.name: Target must clear round-trip cost by 3x
rules.conditionText: Expected gross target (Rs) must be >= 3x estimated round-trip charges + slippage.

evidence.note: 5-10% premium targets are extremely cost-sensitive; see docs/04-risk-and-profit-management.md.

rules.name: Max bid-ask spread
rules.conditionText: Bid-ask spread > max(2 ticks, 0.5% of mid) for NSE/BSE index options; > 1% for MCX options.

evidence.note: Spread is a guaranteed cost on both entry and exit.

rules.name: Minimum OI/volume depth
rules.conditionText: Strike OI < 5x order quantity, or session volume < 20x order quantity, or premium < Rs20 -> block.

evidence.note: Thin strikes slip; cheap options have the worst cost-to-premium ratio.

rules.name: Block COPPER/ZINC options unless liquidity proven live
rules.conditionText: Block options on COPPER, ZINC unless G-LIQ-SPREAD and G-LIQ-DEPTH both pass live.

evidence.note: MCX options liquidity is concentrated in crude, natural gas, gold, silver; copper/zinc trade as futures only on this platform (see MCX_BASEMETAL_FUT_TREND).

rules.name: Block short premium on VIX spike
rules.conditionText: India VIX up >8% intraday, or prior close >14.5, blocks naked/semi-naked short premium; long options go to WATCH.

evidence.note: Straddle-width strangle lost Rs24,039 on days after VIX>14.5; short-futures fade worked best with VIX 11.5-14.5.

rules.name: Avoid breakout buys in a choppy regime
rules.conditionText: If the first two 30-min bars overlap >70% and ADX(14,30m) < 18, avoid breakout buys; prefer defined-risk premium selling.

evidence.note: Breakout buying loses on range days; strangle lost on choppy days (33% win over 66 days).

rules.name: Prefer long side on breakouts
rules.conditionText: Prefer CE on breakouts; require extra confirmation for PE breakouts.

evidence.note: Zerodha ORB study (Sandeep Rao, Mar 2026; NIFTY spot, 3-min candles, Jan 2019-Feb 2026, before costs): long win ~60% vs ~50% short.

rules.name: Gap-risk filter
rules.conditionText: Gap >0.8% vs prior close (incl. after holidays/long weekends): no entries until the 10:15 bar; never fade the gap with naked shorts.

evidence.note: Quantsapp: 38 gap-up openings lost Rs1,02,423 for an intraday short; small gap fade -Rs3.6k.

rules.name: Blackout around index macro events
rules.conditionText: No entries 15 min before to 30 min after Budget speech, RBI MPC announcement, US Fed decision (next-morning gap), major exit-poll/election results.

evidence.note: Event jumps exceed premium stops.

rules.name: Blackout around MCX-relevant US data releases
rules.conditionText: Crude: Wed EIA 19:45-20:30 IST (DST)/20:45-21:30 (winter); NatGas: Thu EIA storage same windows; bullion: US CPI/NFP 17:45-18:30/18:45-19:30; OPEC+ meetings.

evidence.note: Spreads widen and stops gap through at the release.

rules.name: No MCX option positions into expiry
rules.conditionText: No MCX option positions held into the option's expiry day after 17:00; no new entries in expiring options on expiry day.

evidence.note: MCX options are mostly options on futures -- ITM options devolve into futures on expiry.

rules.name: Avoid entries near the MCX price band
rules.conditionText: New entries blocked when the futures price is within 0.5% of the current daily price band (3% base -> 6% -> 9% after a 15-min cooling-off).

evidence.note: A limit move freezes exits.

rules.name: No averaging into a loser
rules.conditionText: No adding to losing positions; no martingale sizing.

evidence.note: SEBI notes loss amplification from doubling down.

rules.name: Block on stale market data
rules.conditionText: Option-chain snapshot >60s old, missing candle, or LTP outside bid-ask -> block.

evidence.note: Prevents trading on bad data. Already implemented for suggestions via MAX_DATA_AGE_SECONDS in run_service.py.

rules.name: Operational kill switch on execution health
rules.conditionText: >=3 order rejects or slippage >2x expected in a session -> halt and alert.

evidence.note: Operational kill switch, independent of market-side risk.

rules.name: New strategies must prove themselves in paper mode
rules.conditionText: A strategy must have >=60 paper trades, positive expectancy after costs, and max drawdown within budget before promotion to LIVE.

evidence.note: Backtests overstate live results; live results commonly run 15-30% worse than backtests.
